newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end in buoyant mood, upside seen.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end in buoyant mood, upside seen.

text.p: 1630 GMT - Shares ended firmer overall, with some stocks putting in spectacular gains, and traders said that the positive mood could be extended on Monday providing there is no sharp fall in New York later today.
*"The market is pretty optimistic about certain stocks...(and) this could continue to have an impact," said one trader.

*Inparsa soared 17 percent to 3,450 escudos after the Belmiro de Azevedo group announced on Thursday evening that it would be the vehicle for his group's bid for Portugal's third mobile phone concession.

*Its good profit outlook, together with that of its wood products unit Sonae Industria, which gained nearly eight percent, did the rest, traders said. Traders see Inparsa moving above 3,500 before a decision on the cellular phone business is announced late in 1997.
*Banco Espirito Santo hit a high of 5,050 before settling at 5,000 escudos, up 2.7 percent on the day. The bank has been rising strongly since announcing first half results earlier this year.

*Overall volume was a massive 100 billion escudos but 80 percent of this was generated by previously announced purchase by Banco Comercial Portugues of a further 25 percent of Banco Portugues do Atlantico from insurer Imperio.
*There were some problems towards the close with prices quoted on the Reuters system due to a technical fault.
